hooks.name: Static analysis on save
hooks.description: Report-only: runs every step (ESLint across src and quality/hooks/desktop/mcp/harness scripts, circular imports, layer boundaries, size limits) when source or those scripts are saved, prints a FAILED line per failing step and always exits 0.

action.command: f=0; for c in 'npm run quality:lint' 'node scripts/quality/check-cycles.mjs' 'node scripts/quality/check-layers.mjs' 'node scripts/quality/check-size.mjs src scripts/desktop'; do sh -c "$c" 2>&1 || { f=$((f+1)); echo "FAILED (report-only): run $c"; }; done; [ $f -eq 0 ] && echo 'static analysis: all steps passed' || echo "static analysis: $f step(s) FAILED"; exit 0
